title: EuroCIM 2027 Paris, France
text:
The conference will be from 14-16 April 2027, with pre-conference courses on the 13th.
More information coming soon!

Alex Luedtke is a Professor of Health Care Policy and Affiliate in Statistics at Harvard University.







Émilie Kaufmann is a a CNRS researcher in the CRIStAL at Université de Lille.







Sara Magliacane is a full Professor at Saarland University since 2026 and is also part of the Amsterdam Machine Learning Lab at the University Amsterdam.
